name: memory_persist
description: Write a named fact to the persistent cross-mission memory store. Use this to save important findings, user preferences, or recurring context that should be available in future Axion missions.

key.description: Unique identifier for this memory entry (alphanumeric, underscores, hyphens, max 64 chars). Example: 'user_industry', 'preferred_chart_style'

value.description: The fact or context to remember. Be concise — max 2000 chars.
